tldr: Capricorn rising: composed, capable, and oriented toward earned authority.
body: With Capricorn rising, you meet life through responsibility, restraint, and the instinct to build something that lasts. Your path asks you to mature without turning tenderness into a liability.
approach: Plans carefully, carries responsibility, and earns trust through consistency.
shadow: Overcontrol, guardedness, or believing you must prove your right to exist through achievement.
note: Authored from approved project Big Three and sign material.
